caption: Landwasser Viaduct, Filisur
composition: Landwasser Viaduct curving into the cliff tunnel near Filisur · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Landwasser Viaduct curves on six limestone arches above the forested gorge, and the single track leaves the last span straight into a tunnel in the cliff. The masonry is the pale dolomitic limestone of the 1902 Rhaetian Railway bridge, about 65 metres high, between Schmitten and Filisur. No construction scaffold is added, and no train carries a readable mark. The Open-Meteo model sets the light in the gorge.
